title: Composer
summary: The message field at the bottom of a chat: plain text with Markdown, send, the attachment and sticker buttons, the microphone when the field is empty, and a draft per chat that survives closing the app.

text.description: The field. Markdown is written as text; there is no formatting toolbar.

mode.description: reply and edit come from message-reply and message-edit. Saved in the draft as ComposerDraftType.

canSend.description: true when the trimmed text is not empty. Shows send in place of the microphone.

isBlocked.description: The composer is off: the DM is blocked or the person can't post (ADR 0141). The bar of that state replaces the field.

send.effect: newMessage: Timeline.send with messageEventContentFromMarkdown(text). reply and edit: as in message-reply and message-edit. Clears text and the saved draft (Room.clearComposerDraft).

saveDraft.effect: When the chat closes or the app goes to the background: Room.saveComposerDraft with the plain text and the mode. Blank text clears the draft.

loadDraft.effect: When the chat opens: Room.loadComposerDraft fills text and mode.

paste.effect: Pasted text goes in the field. A pasted image opens media-upload-preview with it.

notes: Markdown subset the SDK renders: bold, italic, strikethrough, inline code, code blocks, lists, quotes and links. The body keeps the Markdown text as the plain fallback.
No @ or # suggestions in a DM (ADR 0141). @ mentions in groups are bipe-chat/bipe#569 work; phase 1 sends no mentions.
The field grows to 6 lines, then scrolls. Return inserts a new line on phones; send is the button.
The draft lives in the SDK store on this device only. It is not synced to other devices.
Rich text editing is phase 3 (plan section 4).
